identity.title: Palo Verde Nuclear Generating Station (PVNGS) Unit 1

cause.proximate_text: control room staff did not recognize that there was an equipment issue that affected the operability of the Train A HPSI before declaring the Train B HPSI inoperable for planned outage activities. The apparent cause of this event is less than adequate communication.
cause.theme: Communication failure between operator and control room supervisor

nodes.display_name: Train B HPSI declared inoperable for planned RWT recirculation

nodes.display_name: Train A EC Chiller confirmed inoperable, affecting Train A HPSI
nodes.description: At 0106 on March 28, 2025, Train A EC Chiller was declared inoperable when compressor oil temperature was confirmed below minimum, rendering Train A HPSI room cooling unavailable and Train A HPSI inoperable

nodes.display_name: Concurrent Train A and B HPSI inoperability; TS LCO 3.0.3 entered / SSFF
Return Train B HPSI to normal lineup
Develop briefings on conduct of operations communication practices

chain: AO/CRS miscommunication about which chiller had low oil temperature [cause A] -> Train B HPSI declared inoperable for planned RWT recirculation (unaware Train A HPSI already affected) -> Train A EC Chiller confirmed inoperable, rendering Train A HPSI inoperable -> concurrent Train A & B HPSI inoperability, TS LCO 3.0.3 entered / SSFF -> Train B HPSI returned to normal lineup, LCO exited
